annotations.category_path: Veterans’ Disability Compensation and Pension Programs / Veterans / Adjustment for Payday Shifta
annotations.variable_note: 38 U.S. Code § 5120 directs that if the first day of the month occurs on a holiday or weekend, the Department of Veterans Affairs will make benefit payments on the preceding business day. That will result in one additional paycheck in fiscal years 2028 and 2033 and one fewer paycheck in fiscal years 2024 and 2029.
